# Vendored browser libraries

Fetched unmodified for the local HUD viewer. Not part of the Python package and
not shipped in the wheel.

| file | project | version | licence |
|---|---|---|---|
| three.module.js, OrbitControls.js, STLLoader.js, GLTFLoader.js, BufferGeometryUtils.js | three.js | 0.160.0 | MIT |
| URDFLoader.js, URDFClasses.js | urdf-loader | 0.12.1 | Apache-2.0 |

Both permissive; neither reaches project source.
